task: Make release-unit modify materialization preserve safe current-main evolution by applying the immutable source commit's intended per-file patch with deterministic three-way semantics instead of replacing the target file with the historical source blob.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The bounded rehearsal reached U03 after U01 and U02 both merged through trusted exact-head proof. U03 source intent changed tests/control-plane-release-unit-production-surface.test.ts by only +18/-1 relative to the immutable source commit parent, but materializeReleaseUnit replaced the current-main file with the historical sealed source blob, producing +19/-580 against current main. Edit-Time Reference Sync correctly blocked that destructive regression. The defect is therefore in modify materialization: a sealed source blob is appropriate for create, but a modify operation must carry the immutable source commit's intended patch onto the current reconciled target base or fail closed on conflict.
observableOutcomes: For a modify operation, the materialized result preserves unrelated target-base changes while applying the immutable source commit's intended per-file delta.
The materializer derives the modify delta from the immutable source commit and its unique parent, not from mutable workspace state.
A clean three-way application produces a deterministic target blob and materialization commit.
A conflicting modify fails closed with an explicit machine-readable error naming the file; no partial tree or branch update is produced.
Create operations continue to materialize the exact sealed source blob; delete, rename and regenerate semantics are unchanged by this fix.
Reference Sync remains strict and is not bypassed or weakened.
Replaying the unchanged rehearsal source produces a corrected U03 whose production-surface test preserves post-source Control Plane additions instead of deleting hundreds of lines.
unresolvedRisks: Using the wrong source parent could derive a patch unrelated to the immutable source transaction.
A three-way merge implementation could accidentally stage unrelated worktree changes.
Binary, mode-only or rename-like changes must not be silently misinterpreted as ordinary textual modify.
An empty or malformed source diff must not silently fall back to full historical blob replacement.
A conflict must not create a partially materialized release-unit commit.
Create behavior must remain exact-blob and must not inherit patch semantics from modify.

in: Add deterministic source-parent and patch-aware modify materialization in scripts/lib/shoperation-release-unit-runtime.mjs.
Use isolated temporary Git state/worktree rooted at the exact targetBaseSha for three-way patch application.
Read the resulting staged blob/mode from Git and insert only that result into the release-unit materialization tree.
Fail closed on non-unique source parent, missing/empty modify delta, three-way conflict or inability to resolve the staged result.
Add production-surface regressions proving preservation of unrelated current-main additions, exact intended source change, and conflict blocking.
out: No change to Reference Sync classification or thresholds.
No direct modification of PR #1074 or its materialized branch.
No mutation of the immutable source branch or source SHA 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65.
No broad auto-merge engine for arbitrary repository conflicts.
No changes to storefront, templates, Supabase, deployment or product runtime behavior.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Materialization is a trusted write path. A wrong merge can silently delete later main fixes, while an over-strict implementation can deadlock valid resumable releases. The fix must therefore prove both preservation and conflict rejection.

acceptanceCriteria: Modify materialization derives its patch from sourceCommit^ to sourceCommit for the exact operation file and requires a unique source parent.
The patch is applied with Git three-way/index semantics to an isolated checkout rooted at exact targetBaseSha.
Unrelated lines added on target base after the source commit remain present in the materialized file.
The immutable source commit's intended modify hunk appears exactly once in the materialized file.
A conflicting target-base edit throws an explicit RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT:<file> blocker and creates no materialized commit.
A missing or unusable source delta throws an explicit fail-closed materialization error rather than reverting to source-blob overwrite.
Create operations still use sealed source blob identity and are unchanged by the new helper.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
After merge, the immutable rehearsal source is replayed and U03 advances beyond the current Edit-Time/Reference Sync failure without manual child-PR edits.
invariants: A modify operation may not replace a target file wholesale merely because the source blob differs.
The target base remains the exact leased/reconciled main SHA.
The source patch is derived only from the immutable sealed source commit and its parent.
No conflict is auto-resolved by preferring source or target wholesale.
No partial materialization may survive a failed modify patch.
Reference Sync remains authoritative over the resulting child diff.
Create/delete/rename/regenerate contracts remain behaviorally unchanged unless separately planned.

failureModes: Modify still uses sealed historical blob and deletes later main changes.
Patch is generated against the wrong source parent.
Three-way apply reports conflict but code still writes a commit.
Patch application stages files outside operation.file.
Mode/binary edge cases produce a result that cannot be bound to a staged blob.
Regression test passes only on synthetic trivial files and misses preservation of unrelated target additions.
edgeCases: source commit has exactly one parent and target base has unrelated additions around the changed hunk
target base edits the same hunk and must conflict
source modify diff is empty for the declared file
target file already contains the exact source change plus unrelated additions
file mode changes together with content
multiple modify operations in one release unit
create operation adjacent to modify operation

alternatives.summary: Derive the immutable source per-file patch and apply it with Git three-way/index semantics to exact target base.
alternatives.reason: Preserves later non-conflicting main evolution while failing closed on real conflicts.

alternatives.summary: Keep writing the historical source blob for modify.
alternatives.reason: Live U03 proved this deletes hundreds of lines of later Control Plane work.

alternatives.summary: Allow the destructive U03 diff by reducing Reference Sync required consumers.
alternatives.reason: Reference Sync correctly detected the regression and must remain strict.

alternatives.summary: Patch PR #1074 manually until CI passes.
alternatives.reason: Would hide the generic trusted materialization defect and break resumable proof.

specialistReviews.finding: A general auto-merge facility could become an uncontrolled source of semantic conflict resolution.
specialistReviews.resolution: Limit the behavior to declared modify operations, exact source parent delta, exact target base, and fail closed on any Git three-way conflict.

specialistReviews.finding: Patch provenance must remain bound to the immutable source commit; workspace-generated patches are unacceptable.
specialistReviews.resolution: Generate the patch directly from Git objects sourceParent→sourceCommit and preserve sealed source identity.

specialistReviews.finding: Current blob overwrite can erase later main changes even when source intent is a small non-conflicting delta.
specialistReviews.resolution: Materialize the staged three-way result blob rather than the historical source blob for modify.

specialistReviews.finding: U01 and U02 already closed; U03 is the final child and is correctly blocked before destructive merge.
specialistReviews.resolution: Repair the generic modify write path, then replay unchanged parent source and require a fresh/superseding U03 proof.

specialistReviews.finding: The rehearsal exposed a previously unmodeled interaction between immutable source blobs and a main that evolved after source creation.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add preservation and conflict regressions so the defect becomes a permanent known boundary.

challenge.scenario: Source modifies two lines; target base has unrelated new tests elsewhere in the same file.
challenge.resolution: Three-way patch keeps unrelated target additions and applies source hunk.

challenge.scenario: Target base edits the same lines as source patch.
challenge.finding: Any automatic side preference could silently corrupt behavior.
challenge.resolution: Git three-way conflict becomes explicit RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT.

challenge.scenario: Source commit has no parent or multiple parents.
Declared modify has no diff between source parent and source commit.
challenge.finding: Falling back to source blob would revive the bug.
challenge.resolution: Fail closed with explicit missing/empty modify delta error.

challenge.scenario: Target base already contains the source hunk plus unrelated additions.
challenge.finding: Patch may report already applied or fail context matching.
challenge.resolution: Detect Git result deterministically and treat exact already-applied semantic state without losing unrelated content.

challenge.scenario: Release unit also creates a new fixture file.
challenge.finding: Modify patch logic must not alter create provenance semantics.
challenge.resolution: Branch logic by operation type; create remains exact sealed blob.

challenge.scenario: Patch stages another file through rename/path metadata.
challenge.resolution: Verify staged paths are exactly the declared modify file before accepting result.

challenge.scenario: Patch application fails after previous operations were staged in the temporary index.
challenge.resolution: Materialization remains transactional in temporary Git state; no commit/update-ref on any thrown error.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS before modifying runtime or tests.
Implement modify-only patch materialization in scripts/lib/shoperation-release-unit-runtime.mjs without changing create/delete/rename/regenerate semantics.
Add production-surface regressions using a temporary Git repository that proves preservation of later target additions and fail-closed same-hunk conflict.
Require existing materialization resume/supersession tests to remain PASS.
Run exact-head Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Incremental Replay/Release Risk/Quality/TypeScript/Build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle proof.
Merge only after exact PR-head proof and green main CI.
Replay immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65; do not edit PR #1074 manually; require corrected U03 materialization and trusted exact-head child proof.

requirements.requirement: Release-unit modify materialization must apply the immutable source transaction delta to the exact reconciled target base without deleting unrelated later main changes, and must fail closed on conflict.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A modify operation may not replace a current target file wholesale with a historical source blob.
A conflicting source patch may not be auto-resolved by preferring either side.
Create operations must retain exact sealed source blob semantics.

notes: Live evidence: immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 changed tests/control-plane-release-unit-production-surface.test.ts by +18/-1 relative to parent b79f8805d9718961a5cb41d4babaf11fd85dda5a. U03 materialization PR #1074 against main 1bf9ced0ca0e2c0547c655b60c2a94b8ddd5d100 produced +19/-580 because modify wrote the historical sealed blob. Trusted child CI #9095 correctly failed Edit-Time Reference Sync before merge. The fix targets modify materialization; Reference Sync remains authoritative.
